_comment: Track-2 forecasting DATA-SPEC (panels/targets/scoring). This is NOT the per-file checksum manifest. The canonical checksum manifest is manifest.json (manifest_version 2.0, unit_id, files[]); a data-spec must not be named manifest.json or qfbench2_common.manifest.verify_manifest will reject it for having no files[] array. NOTE the two different uses of 'frequency': panels[].frequency is how often the PANEL is observed, while targets.horizons are always in BUSINESS DAYS. The two were previously inconsistent in this template -- a monthly panel paired with a 21-business-day horizon -- which is the kind of contradiction an author copies without noticing.
_output_format_note: 'samples' is the ONLY accepted representation. 'parametric' was advertised by the shared schema, implemented by nothing, and was a route past the 200-draw floor; the scorer refuses it.
_n_draws_note: n_draws_min is AUTHORITATIVE: the reference producer honours it and the scorer enforces a floor of 200 and a ceiling of 20000 in code, independently of the JSON Schema.
